title: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:01497:20181101:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Appendix <No. 1497, 2018.11.1>

Article 1 (Effective Date) This regulation shall take effect from November 1, 2018.

Article 2 (Amendments Regarding Grounds for Disqualification of Members) Members of the Accounting Standards Committee and the Oversight Committee, appointed or designated prior to the enforcement of the Partial Amendment to the Regulations for the Enforcement of the Act on External Audits of Stock Companies (Prime Minister's Decree No. 1440), shall be considered as not falling under the disqualification grounds specified in Article 3, paragraph 6 or Article 11, paragraph 4 of the amended regulations.

Article 3 (Amendments Regarding the Composition of the Committee) The Accounting Standards Committee and the Oversight Committee, as of the enforcement of the Partial Amendment to the Regulations for the Enforcement of the Act on External Audits of Stock Companies (Prime Minister's Decree No. 1440), shall be considered as the Accounting Standards Committee and the Oversight Committee established in accordance with this regulation.

Article 4 (Amendments Regarding the Term of Office of the Chairman and Members) The Chairman and members of the Accounting Standards Committee and the Oversight Committee, as of the enforcement of the Partial Amendment to the Regulations for the Enforcement of the Act on External Audits of Stock Companies (Prime Minister's Decree No. 1440), shall be considered as the Chairman and members of the Accounting Standards Committee and the Oversight Committee in accordance with this regulation.

It appears that the members were appointed or designated as members of the supervisory committee, and their terms would extend until the expiration of the term at the time of their appointment or designation.

Article 5 (Amendments related to accounting standards, etc.) The provisions of the Prime Minister's Order No. 1440, "Partial Amendment to the Rules for the Implementation of the Act on External Audits of Stock Companies," which were in effect at the time of implementation, are to be considered as the accounting audit standards, accounting standards, and audit standards that were deliberated and approved according to this rule.

Article 6 (Relationship with other laws) If other laws referenced the previous "Rules for the Implementation of the Act on External Audits of Stock Companies" or its provisions at the time of implementation of this rule, and if this rule contains a corresponding provision, it shall be considered as referencing the previous "Rules for the Implementation of the Act on External Audits of Stock Companies" or its provisions instead.

Article 7 (Amendments to other laws) The following provisions of the "Rules for the Implementation of the Act on Capital Markets and Financial Investment" are amended:

  Item 1 of Article 6, Paragraph 1

Change "Article 13(1)(1) of the 'Act on External Auditing of Stock Companies'" to "Article 5(1)(1) of the 'Act on External Auditing of Stock Companies and Other Companies'," and change "Article 3(1) of the 'Act on External Auditing of Stock Companies'" in Article 12(4)(1) to "Article 2(7) of the 'Act on External Auditing of Stock Companies and Other Companies'."
